MON

口袋妖怪

MON.

我的。

不太顺利。

Strength and compassion…

你有时能听到这里有震动。{WAIT_CLEAR}？

不，不，没关系！

You're a fiery battler.

你是个勇猛的战士。
就像火山一样！

You just happened to win this time,

这次你刚好赢了，

One of our guys was freaking out that

我们的一个人吓坏了
他丢了他的岩浆徽章……{WAIT_CLEAR} 等一下!
是你找到的吗？

is going to end in failure…

我觉得我们的计划

ting this feeling that our plan

我做了什么，要招来这个守卫

你觉得我们穿着
在这个充满岩浆的火山中？

We joined so we can help our leader

我们加入是为了帮助我们的领袖

走开！

Oh, no!

哦,不!
你根本不值得信任！

听我说。
岩浆团队是对的！{WAIT_CLEAR}别听水舰队队的。

你知道，输给你让我清醒了。{WAIT_CLEAR} 下次我见到我们的领导时，

我也想去看格鲁东，但是他们
连它的尾巴都不让我看……这让我感到很沮丧。{WAIT_CLEAR}哦,不!

Fuhahaha!

I've come so far, but now this?

我已经走了这么远，但现在呢？

入侵者朝你这边来了！

你还没完成呢！
你不容易接近我!

呵呵呵！
你已经走到这一步了，所以我告诉你！{WAIT_CLEAR}没错！

Taken down again…
Hehe…

马克西应该叫醒格鲁登……

Yes…
I didn't think I could win.
zh:
是。
我不认为我能赢。

en:
I may be weak at battling, but my
drive to explore can't be bested.{WAIT_CLEAR}I will travel the seas all around
the world!
zh: 我在战斗上可能很弱，但我探索的动力无人能敌。我将周游世界的海洋！

en:
I'm exhausted from swimming.
I'm just not used to it.{WAIT_CLEAR}I need a battle for a change of pace!
zh:
我游泳累坏了。
我只是不习惯。{WAIT_CLEAR} 我需要一场改变节奏的战斗!

en: I lost because I battled at sea.
zh: 我输了，因为我在海上作战。

en:
Yeah, for me, the sky is a much better
match than the sea.
zh:
是的，对我来说，天空是一个更好的
比大海更匹配。

en:
Which do you prefer, fishing in the
sea or a stream?
zh:
你更喜欢哪一个，钓鱼吗
大海还是小溪？

en:
Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost
spectacularly!
zh: 就像深海捕鱼一样，我惨败了！

en:
Fishing is the greatest whether it's
in the sea or a stream.{WAIT_SCROLL}You agree with me, right?
zh: 钓鱼是最棒的，无论是在海里还是在小溪里。你同意我的看法，对吧？

en:
Fishing's great, but so is battling.
If you don't mind, can we meet again?
zh:
钓鱼很棒，但战斗也很棒。
如果你不介意的话，我们能再见面吗？

en:
MON fishing.
I'll show you an impressive battle!
zh:
口袋妖怪钓鱼。
我将给你展示一场令人印象深刻的战斗！

en: I lost again spectacularly!
zh: 我又再次惊人地输了！

en:
MON are the greatest!
You agree with me, right?
zh: MON是最棒的！你同意我的看法，对吗？

en:
What do people do if they need to go
to a washroom?{WAIT_CLEAR}What if my ROD hooks a big one while
I'm in the washroom? I just can't go…
zh:
如果人们需要离开，他们会怎么做
去洗手间？{WAIT_CLEAR}如果我的鱼竿钩到一条大鱼怎么办
我在洗手间？我就是不能去……

en:
I lost because I'm trying to not go
to the washroom…
zh:
我输了，因为我试着不去
去洗手间……

en:
Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook
a big one!
zh:
哦,不!我有种感觉，我会上钩的
一个大的！

en:
Hahahah! I'm a lousy runner, but in
the water you can't catch me!
zh:
哈哈哈！h !我跑得很烂，但是
水你抓不住我！

en: I give up!
zh: 我放弃！

en: I wouldn't lose in a swim race…
zh: 我在游泳比赛中不会输……

en:
The sea is my backyard. I'm not going
to take it easy because you're a kid!
zh:
大海是我的后院。我不去
放轻松，因为你还是个孩子！

en:
Did you take it easy on me by any
chance?
zh:
你对我宽容了一点吗
机会吗?

en:
Drifting along with the waves…
I love it! Why don't you give it a try?
zh: 随着波浪漂流……我喜欢它！你为什么不试试呢？

en:
Yawn…{WAIT_CLEAR}I must have drifted off to sleep while
I was drifting in the waves.
zh:
打呵欠我一定是睡着了
我在海浪中漂流。

en:
Ahaha, I lost…
I'll take a snooze, I think…
zh:
哈哈，我输了…
我想我要打个盹，我想…

en:
Floating and being rocked by
the waves--it's like sleeping in{WAIT_SCROLL}a plush, comfy bed.
zh: 漂浮并被海浪摇晃——就像睡在一张豪华舒适的床上。

en:
The sea is like my backyard.
Let's battle!
zh:
大海就像我的后院。 
来战斗吧！

en:
I lost on my home field…
I'm in shock!
zh: 我在主场输了……我在休克!

en:
I swim the seas with a heart full of
dreams…{WAIT_CLEAR}It's a song!
Anyways, I'm swimming some more.
zh: 我带着满心的梦想在海里游泳……{WAIT_CLEAR}这是一首歌！无论如何，我还在继续游泳。

en:
You've shocked me to the bone!
Well, so you won't forget me…
zh:
你吓得我魂飞魄散！
这样你就不会忘记我了…

en: MON has grown stronger!
zh: MON变得更强大了！

en:
MON has gotten stronger, but
I stayed weak as a TRAINER!
zh:
MON变得更强了，但是
作为一名训练师，我一直很虚弱！

en:
What you learn in battle makes you
a stronger TRAINER.{WAIT_SCROLL}The waves taught me that.
zh:
你在战斗中学到的东西造就了你
更强的训练师。{WAIT_CLEAR}海浪教会了我这一点。

en:
Do you know a little town called
DEWFORD?
zh: 你知道一个叫做杜福德的小镇吗？

en: I hate this!
zh: 我讨厌这个！

en:
A weird saying is getting really
trendy at DEWFORD HALL.
zh:
一个奇怪的说法是真的
大厅。

en:
Did you want to battle me?
Sure, I'll go with you!
zh: 你想和我战斗吗？当然，我会跟你去！

en: I wasn't good enough for you.
zh: 我配不上你。

en:
I think you're going to keep getting
better. I'll go for it, too!
zh: 我觉得你会继续变得更好。我也会尝试一下！

en:
LISA: We challenge you as a sister
and brother!
zh: ：我们以姐姐的身份挑战你，还有兄弟！

en:
LISA: Awesome.
You're in a different class of tough.
zh:
丽莎:太棒了。
你属于另一种类型的硬汉。

en:
LISA: Do you have any friends who
would go to the beach with you?
zh:
莉莎：你有没有朋友
会和你一起去海滩吗？

en: MON.
zh: 我的。

en:
MON,
me and my sister.{WAIT_CLEAR}I always lose, but we can beat you
2-on-2!
zh:
星期一，
我和我妹妹。{WAIT_CLEAR} 我总是输，但我们可以打败你
2-on-2!

en:
RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level
than us!
zh: RAY: 哇哦，你的水平比我们高！

en:
MON.
I raised it, and now it's my important{WAIT_SCROLL}partner!
zh:
我的。
我养大了它，现在它是我重要的伙伴！

en: MON!
zh: 我的!

en:
I'm in the middle of a triathlon,
but I'm nowhere near tired!
zh:
我正在进行三项全能运动，
但我一点也不累！

en: That exhausted me…
zh: 这使我筋疲力尽……

en:
I still have swimming and running left
to do after this.{WAIT_CLEAR}Am I going to be okay?
zh: 在这之后我还有游泳和跑步要做。我会没事吧？

en:
My dream is to swim the world's seven
seas!
zh:
我的梦想是游世界七
海!

en:
I won't be able to swim the seven seas
like this…
zh:
我不会游过七大洋
像这样…

en:
MON is one of
the pleasures of swimming!
zh:
MON是其中之一
游泳的乐趣!

en:
Ahoy, there! Are you going out to
the ABANDONED SHIP, too?
zh: 啊，你好！你也要去那个被遗弃的船吗？

en:
I'm sinking!
Glub… Glub…
zh:
我在下沉！
咕噜……咕噜……

en:
Some people even go inside that
ABANDONED SHIP.
zh: 有些人甚至会进入那艘废弃的船里。

en:
My liar of a boyfriend told me that
I look great in a bikini…
zh: 我那个爱撒谎的男朋友告诉我，我穿比基尼看起来很棒…

en: Oh, boo!
zh: 哦,嘘!

en:
Even if it's a lie, I love being told
I look great…{WAIT_SCROLL}We girls are so complex…
zh:
即使是谎言，我也喜欢别人告诉我
我看起来棒极了我们女孩子都很复杂

en:
I love the sea!
I forget all my worries when I swim!
zh:
我爱大海！
当我游泳时，我忘记了所有的烦恼!

en:
When I lose a battle, I get all
stressed out!
zh:
当我输了一场战斗，我得到了一切
强调了!

en:
Work off your stress by swimming!
It's so healthy!
zh:
通过游泳来消除你的压力！
太健康了！

en: MON, too!
zh: 我的!

en:
Waaah! I lost!
Waaah! Waaah!
zh:
哇啊！我输了！
哇啊！哇啊！

en:
Shouting is good for me!
It uplifts me!
zh:
大喊大叫对我有好处！
它使我振奋！

en: NAV!
zh: 导航器!

en: Win or lose, I love battling at sea!
zh: 无论输赢，我都喜欢在海上作战！

en:
Waaah! I lost again!
Waaah! Waaah!
zh:
哇啊！我又输了！
哇啊！哇啊！

en:
If you're faced with a challenge,
try shouting at the sea!
zh:
如果你面临挑战，
试着对着大海喊！

en:
I take huge pride in my POKéMON.
We'll show you one speedy battle!
zh:
我对我的郁闷感到非常自豪。
我们将向你展示一场快速的战斗！

en:
MON.
We'll show you one speedy battle!
zh: 宝可梦。我们将向你展示一场快速的战斗！

en: That wasn't cute at all.
zh: 这一点也不可爱。

en:
Since I'm at sea like this, I wouldn't
mind putting on a pink, frilly swimsuit…
zh:
既然我在海上，我就不会
介意穿上粉红色的有褶边的泳衣吗？

en:
Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs!
This is what you call “cut”!
zh: 嗨呀！看看我那雕刻般的腹肌！这就是你所谓的“结实”！

en:
Aiyah!
Flubbed out!
zh: 哎呀！搞砸了！

en: MON battles!
zh: 口袋妖怪战斗!

en:
Are you properly protected against
the sun?
zh:
你是否有适当的防护措施
太阳?

en: Ouch, ouch, ouch!
zh: 哎哟，哎哟，哎哟！

en: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!
zh: 脸颊最容易被晒伤！

en:
I've laid anchor in ports around
the world, but SLATEPORT's the best.
zh:
我在周围的港口下过锚
但凯那市是最好的。

en: You're the best!
zh: 你是最棒的！

en:
In the best port was the best
TRAINER…
zh:
在最好的港口是最好的
教练……

en:
Urrrrppp…
Battle? With me?
zh: ……吗？和我在一起吗？

en:
Urp… Ooooooohhhhhh…
Urrrrpppp…
zh: 呃哼……噢哦哦哦哦……呃唔……

en:
I'm usually stronger than this!
I'm just seasick as a dog!{WAIT_CLEAR}I'm a SAILOR, but…
zh: 我通常比这更坚强！我只是晕船晕得厉害！我是水手，但是…

en:
I'm thirsty… I could go for a SODA POP
at the SEASHORE HOUSE…
zh: 我渴了……我想去海边屋喝汽水……

en: Groan…
zh: 哼…

en:
I'm getting famished… My inner tube
looks like a giant doughnut…
zh:
我饿了… 我的内胎
看起来像一个巨大的甜甜圈…

en:
Will you have another match with me
when I'm not all thirsty?
zh:
你愿意和我再比赛一场吗
当我不渴的时候？

en:
I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in
me for a battle!
zh:
我饿了，但我已经有足够的勇气了
我要战斗!

en:
I lost…
It's because I'm hungry…
zh: 我输了……因为我饿了……

en:
When you eat on a beach, everything
seems to taste a little better.
zh: 当你在海滩上吃东西时，一切似乎都尝起来更好一点。

en:
Doesn't a beach umbrella look like
a giant flower?
zh: 海滩伞看起来像一朵巨大的花，不是吗？

en: Mommy!
zh: 妈妈!

en:
If you look at the beach from the sky,
it looks like a big flower garden!
zh: 如果你从空中看海滩，它看起来像一个巨大的花园！

en:
Me?
I'm here every day!
zh: 我？我每天都在这里！

en:
I'm not losing to you again!
That's why I have my inner tube!
zh:
我不要再输给你了！
所以我才有内胎！

en: Mommy!
zh: 妈妈!

en:
If I have an inner tube, me and my
POKéMON's cuteness goes way up!
zh:
如果我有内胎，我和我的
宝可梦的可爱度大大提升了！

en: MON's cuteness goes way up!
zh: 《口袋妖怪》的可爱程度大大提升了！

en: MON!
zh: 我的!

en:
Did I lose because I have an inner
tube?
zh: 我是不是因为有内胎才输的？

en:
My inner tube is a fashion item.
I can't be seen without it.
zh:
我的内胎是时尚单品。
没有它我不能被看见。

en:
Hi, big TRAINER.
Will you battle with me?
zh:
嗨，大教练。
你愿意和我一起战斗吗？

en: Oh, you're strong.
zh: 哦，你很坚强。

en: How did you get to be so strong?
zh: 你是怎么变得这么强壮的？

en:
Wahahah! This dude's going to catch
himself a big one!
zh: 哇哈哈哈！这个家伙要钓到大鱼了！

en: This dude just lost one…
zh: 这家伙刚丢了一个…

en:
This dude thinks you're a big one.
No, you're a big-one-to-be!
zh:
这个家伙认为你是个大人物。
不，你是个未来的大人物！

en:
PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker.{WAIT_CLEAR}I wish you wouldn't disturb our
precious time together.
zh: 保罗：嗯，这真扫兴。{WAIT_CLEAR}我希望你不要打扰我们宝贵的共处时光。

en: PAUL: Well, I give up.
zh: 保罗：好吧，我放弃了。

en:
PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that
we're here.{WAIT_SCROLL}This is just our private world of two!
zh: 保罗：好吧，不要告诉任何人我们在这里。这只是我们两个人的私人世界！

en: MON battle{WAIT_SCROLL}together.
zh: 口袋妖怪战斗 {WAIT_SCROLL} 在一起。

en:
MEL: We're, like, totally in love.
Our romance is heating up all of HOENN!
zh:
梅尔: 我们完全相爱了。
我们的浪漫正在加热整个丰缘!

en:
MEL: We lost, and it's my fault!
PAUL will hate me!
zh: 梅尔：我们输了，这是我的错！保罗会恨我的！

en:
MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me?
Please don't be angry.
zh:
梅尔: 嗯，保罗，你生我的气了吗？
请别生气。

en: MON{WAIT_SCROLL}battle together.
zh: 星期一 {WAIT_SCROLL} 一起战斗。

en:
Tadaah! See?
My inner tube's round!
zh:
瞧！看到了吗？
我的内胎是圆的！

en:
Oh, oh!
Too bad!
zh:
哦,哦!
太糟糕了!

en:
After I showed you my round inner
tube, too…
zh: 在我也给你看了我的圆形内胎之后……

en:
I can't swim, so I'm pretending
to swim.
zh: 我不会游泳，所以我假装在游泳。

en:
I thought so!
I didn't think we could win.
zh: 我也是这么想的！我本以为我们赢不了。

en: MON will become tougher.
zh: 精灵宝可梦会变得更强。

en: MON is the perfect match!
zh: 口袋妖怪是完美的匹配！

en: I'm cool even in defeat, hey?
zh: 即使失败了，我也很酷，对吧？

en:
For a guy as macho as me, a port
is the perfect setting!{WAIT_CLEAR}I guess I'll head for SLATEPORT.
zh:
对于像我这样有男子气概的人来说，一个港口
是完美的设定！{WAIT_CLEAR}我想我会去凯那市。

en:
Whoa! Watch it!
I guess you're not used to BIKE racing.
zh:
哇!小心!
我猜你不习惯自行车比赛。

en:
Whoa!
My brakes failed!
zh:
哇!
我的刹车失灵了！

en:
Flat tires and brake problems can
cause serious injury!{WAIT_SCROLL}Inspect your BIKE for problems!
zh: 轮胎瘪了和刹车故障可能会导致严重伤害！{WAIT_SCROLL}检查你的自行车是否有问题！

en:
Yo, you!
Can you keep up with my speed?
zh:
哟,你!
你能跟上我的速度吗？

en: Crash and burn!
zh: 撞击而燃烧！

en:
Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON.
I need to reconsider this…
zh:
光靠速度是赢不了我的。
我需要重新考虑一下……

en:
MON.
I need to reconsider this…
zh:
口袋妖怪。
我需要重新考虑一下……

en: Don't panic if your BIKE's going fast!
zh: 如果你的自行车开得很快，不要惊慌！

en:
MON
battles…
zh:
我的
战斗……

en:
There's no need to panic or stress.
Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
zh: 没必要惊慌或紧张。放轻松。有足够的时间。

en:
I'll keep chugging on without stressing.
Give me a shout if you're up to it.
zh:
我会毫无压力地继续下去。
如果你能做到，就喊我一喊。

en:
Aren't you going a little too fast?
Take it easy and let's battle.
zh: 你是不是跑得太快了？慢慢来，我们来战斗吧。

en: I didn't panic, but I still lost…
zh: 我没有惊慌，但我仍然输了……

en:
There's no need to panic or stress.
Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
zh: 没必要惊慌或紧张。放轻松。有足够的时间。

en:
The triathlon is hard in the extreme.{WAIT_CLEAR}You have to complete the three events
of swimming, cycling, and running.
zh: 铁人三项极其艰难。你必须完成游泳、骑行和跑步这三项比赛。

en: MON battles are hard, too!
zh: 《口袋妖怪》的战斗也很难！

en:
I'm exhausted, so I need a break.
It's important to get proper rest.
zh: 我累坏了，所以我需要休息。得到适当的休息很重要。

en:
You know, I like you!
Let's have a rematch on CYCLING ROAD.
zh:
你知道，我喜欢你!
让我们在自行车道上重赛。

en:
Isn't it neat to hold a battle while
cycling?
zh:
一边打一边打不是很爽吗
 骑自行车？

en:
Wow…
How could you be so strong?
zh: 哇… 你怎么能这么强？

en: Were you going after a record?{WAIT_CLEAR}I'm sorry if I held you up!
zh: 你是想创造一张唱片吗？如果耽误了你的时间，我很抱歉！

en:
I've been riding without stopping.
My thighs are like rocks!
zh: 我一直在骑行，停都没停过。我的大腿像石头一样！

en: thighs are like rocks!
zh: 大腿像石头！

en: I'm worried about muscle cramps…
zh: 我担心肌肉痉挛…

en:
Oh, you have some GYM BADGES?
No wonder you're so strong!
zh:
哦，你有健身徽章吗？
难怪你这么强壮！

en:
I have foreseen your intentions!
I cannot possibly lose!
zh:
我已经预见到你的意图了!
我不可能输!

en: I failed to prophesize my own demise!
zh: 我未能预言自己的灭亡！

en:
I see your future…{WAIT_CLEAR}Hmm…
I see a shining light…
zh: 我看到了你的未来……嗯……我看到一道闪光……

en:
Ahahahaha!
I'll dazzle you with my wonders!
zh:
哈哈哈哈哈!
我会用我的奇迹让你眼花缭乱!

en: I wondrously lost!
zh: 我竟然输了！

en:
You managed to win only because it was
a wonder! Yes, a wonder!{WAIT_SCROLL}Don't think you can win all the time!
zh: 你之所以获胜只是因为这是一个奇迹！是的，一个奇迹！{WAIT_SCROLL}别以为你能一直赢！

en:
MON?
Just one look, please?
zh:
口袋妖怪吗?
就看一眼好吗？

en:
I wanted to complete
my collection…
zh: 我想完成我的收藏…

en:
MON that I don't know,
my passion as a collector is ignited!
zh:
我不知道，
我作为收藏家的热情被点燃了！

en:
I like collecting MATCH CALL
registrations, too…
zh: 我也喜欢收集比赛呼叫注册…

en:
MON?
Just one look, please?
zh:
口袋妖怪吗?
就看一眼好吗？

en:
MON…
I envy you.
zh: 我的……我真羡慕你。

en:
MON
mine!
zh:
宝可梦
我的！

en:
Hey!
Don't sneak up behind me like that!
zh:
嘿!
别那样从后面偷偷地靠近我！

en:
I lost!
Drat!
zh:
我失去了!

hate to lose against?
zh:
你有对手吗
讨厌输给对手？

en:
whom you just
hate to lose against?
zh:
你刚才是谁？
讨厌输给对手？

en:
Arrrgh!
I hate losing!
zh: 啊啊啊！我讨厌输！

en:
If you have a rival, don't you get the
feeling that you have to keep getting{WAIT_SCROLL}better?
zh: 如果你有一个对手，你难道不会觉得自己必须不断变得更好吗？

en:
Through fishing, I have attained a
state of becalmed serenity…{WAIT_CLEAR}Please, allow me to demonstrate…
zh: 通过钓鱼，我获得了一种风平浪静的宁静状态……{WAIT_CLEAR}请允许我演示一下……

en:
Though I have lost, my heart remains
calm…
zh:
虽然我已经失去了，我的心仍然
冷静…

en:
It matters not that I catch nothing.
The line remains in the water…
zh:
我是否什么都没钓到并不重要。
鱼线仍然在水中……

en: MON?
zh: 宝可梦？

en: I can't keep up!
zh: 我跟不上！

en: MON!
zh: 我的!

en: MON fan and a fishing buff!
zh: 宝可梦迷和钓鱼爱好者！

en:
No! My line's all tangled!
The party's over!
zh:
不！我的线都纠结了!
派对结束了!

en:
My fishing line's doing a dance!
The tangle tango! Hahaha, snarl!
zh:
我的钓鱼线在跳舞！ 
缠结探戈！哈哈哈，纠结！

en:
MON have excellent vision.
They spot prey from great heights.
zh: MON有出色的视力。他们能从高空发现猎物。

en: Whew… I give up.
zh: 呼……我放弃了。

en:
There're lots of diving spots in
the sea around here.{WAIT_CLEAR}You can spot them easily from the sky
because of their darker color.
zh: 这里海里有很多潜水点。{WAIT_CLEAR}你可以很容易从空中发现它们，因为它们的颜色更深。

en:
Run in your bare feet.
That will toughen up your soles!
zh: 赤脚跑步。那会使你的脚底变得更坚韧！

en:
Yowch!
I got a pebble under a toenail!
zh:
哎呀！
我的脚趾甲下面有一颗小石子！

en:
Going barefoot feels great.
But your RUNNING SHOES are cool, too.
zh: 赤脚的感觉很棒。 但你的跑鞋也很酷。

en:
This is what I do to people who beat me!
I hope we can do this again.
zh:
我就是这么对待打我的人的！
我希望我们能再来一次。

en:
I still run in my bare feet daily.
My soles are tough!
zh:
我仍然每天赤脚跑步。
我的鞋底很坚硬!

en:
Yowch!
Pebbles dug into my arches!
zh: 哎呀！小石子扎进了我的脚弓！

en:
Want to go barefoot for a while?
So I can try your RUNNING SHOES?
zh: 想赤脚一会儿吗？这样我就可以试试你的跑鞋了吗？

en:
We should have a slow and methodical
match.
zh: 我们应该进行一场缓慢而有条理的比赛。

en:
You didn't give me the chance to
do any strategizing.
zh:
你没有给我机会
做任何战略。

en:
When I'm surrounded by the blue sea
and sky, it feels as if time slows down.
zh:
当我被蓝色的大海包围
和天空，感觉好像时间变慢了。

en:
EVER GRANDE CITY is still a long ways
away…
zh: 恒大城还很遥远……

en:
My first victory seems to be far
away, too…
zh:
我的第一次胜利似乎遥遥无期
了,太……

en:
My whole life has been about losing,
but I will never give up!
zh:
我的一生都在经历失败，
但我永远不会放弃！

en: NAV.
zh: 导航。

en:
I'm still feeling good. I'll keep on
swimming to EVER GRANDE CITY.
zh:
我还是感觉很好。我会继续
游向永远的大城市。

en: I've yet to taste my first victory…
zh: 我还没有尝到我的第一次胜利……

en:
I'll eventually reach EVER GRANDE CITY
where I can eventually win…
zh:
我最终会到达永远的大城市
我最终会赢的地方…

en:
You have to swim, cycle, and then run
a marathon in a triathlon.{WAIT_CLEAR}It's a grueling race that consists
of three events.
zh: 在铁人三项比赛中，你必须先游泳、骑自行车，然后跑马拉松。这是一项由三个项目组成的艰苦比赛。

en: MON battle is grueling, too…
zh: 口袋妖怪的战斗也很艰苦…

en:
I have to ride a BIKE next, but…
I'm about to throw in the towel…
zh:
接下来我要骑自行车，但是…
我要认输了…

en:
Well, I may as well make the best
of this. I'd like a rematch sometime.
zh: 好吧，我也只能尽量利用这个机会。我希望有机会再来一场比赛。

en: MON CHAMPION{WAIT_SCROLL}is also a long and grueling one.
zh: 宝可梦冠军{WAIT_SCROLL}也是一条漫长而艰辛的道路。

en:
MON battle really is harsh
and unforgiving…
zh:
MON的战斗真的很残酷
和无情的……

en:
You should give serious thought to
challenges on VICTORY ROAD.
zh:
你应该认真考虑
胜利之路的挑战。

en:
We've been working so hard to mount
a POKéMON LEAGUE challenge…{WAIT_CLEAR}We can't afford to lose now!
zh:
我们一直很努力地想要上马
宝可梦 联盟的挑战…{WAIT_CLEAR}我们现在输不起！

en: MON LEAGUE challenge…{WAIT_CLEAR}We can't afford to lose now!
zh: 我们现在输不起了！

en:
Oh!
How could this happen?!
zh:
哦!
怎么会发生这种事？

en:
After all I've done to get here,
I won't give up after one setback.
zh:
我费了那么大劲才来到这里，
我不会一次挫折就放弃。

en: There is no stronger TRAINER than I!
zh: 没有比我更强的训练师！

en: This can't be!
zh: 这不可能！

en:
There probably is no stronger TRAINER
than you!
zh:
可能没有比他更强的训练师了
比你!

en: MON that knows{WAIT_SCROLL}the move WATERFALL to crest the falls.
zh: 知道技能瀑布来越过瀑布的怪兽。

en: I'm crestfallen!
zh: 我垂头丧气的!

en:
Awww, phooey!{WAIT_CLEAR}My POKéMON knows WATERFALL, but
I don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!
zh:
哇,呸!{WAIT_CLEAR}我的宝可梦知道瀑布，但是
我没有琉棋市健身徽章！

en:
MON knows WATERFALL, but
I don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!
zh:
MON知道瀑布，但是
我没有琉棋市健身房徽章!

en:
You're looking awfully tough.
I wonder if I can win?
zh:
你看起来很坚强。
我想知道我是否能赢？

en:
Ouch!
I guess it was impossible to win.
zh:
哎哟!
我想赢是不可能的。

en:
There are tough TRAINERS galore
around EVER GRANDE.{WAIT_CLEAR}Do you think I may be out
of my league?
zh: 在恒大周围有很多厉害的教练。你觉得我可能力不从心吗？

en:
The sunlight seems to be more harsh
in this area.
zh: 阳光在这个区域似乎更加刺眼。

en:
I couldn't see very well because of
the sun's glare.
zh:
我看不太清楚，因为
太阳的眩光。

en:
I should go back soon.
I need to reapply my sunscreen.
zh:
我应该很快回去。
我需要重新涂防晒霜。

en:
This is my first triathlon.
I'm all tense and nervous!
zh:
这是我第一次参加铁人三项。
我又紧张又紧张！

en:
Wroooaaar!
I failed to win!
zh:
嗷呜！
我没能赢！

en:
If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to
give it my all.
zh: 如果我全身紧张，我就无法全力以赴。

en:
I'm in the middle of a triathlon,
but, sure, why don't we battle?
zh:
我正在参加铁人三项，
但是，当然，我们为什么不战斗？

en: I was sure I'd win!
zh: 我确信我会赢！

en:
Do you know what's the greatest thing
about triathlons?{WAIT_CLEAR}Testing the limits of your own
strength and endurance against{WAIT_SCROLL}Mother Nature!
zh:
你知道最伟大的事情是什么吗
三项全能运动呢?{WAIT_CLEAR}测试你自己的极限
力量和耐力对抗大自然母亲！

en:
Say hey, hey!
Let's get on with it!
zh:
说嘿，嘿!
让我们继续吧!

en:
Beat, I'm beaten.
That's it, done!
zh: 累死了，我被打败了。就这样，完了！

en:
There's nothing for a loser.
Time for me to beat it home.
zh:
失败者一无所有。
我该赶紧回家了。

en:
What's the hurry?
Let's take it slow and easy.
zh:
急什么？ 
让我们慢慢来，轻松一点。

en:
Oh, my.
I wanted to relax a little more…
zh:
天哪。
我想放松一点…

en:
Don't you hate making mistakes when
you're in a rush?{WAIT_CLEAR}That's why I try to take things
slowly.
zh: 你不讨厌在匆忙时犯错误吗？这就是为什么我尽量慢慢做事。

en:
's why I try to take things
slowly.
zh:
这就是为什么我试图拿走东西
缓慢。

en:
Surfing isn't as easy as it seems,
isn't that right?
zh:
冲浪并不像看起来那么容易，
不是吗？

en: Winning sure isn't easy.
zh: 赢得胜利当然不容易。

en:
You have your sights on the POKéMON
LEAGUE? Keep at it!
zh:
你盯上了宝可梦
联盟吗?坚持下去！

en:
MON
LEAGUE? Keep at it!
zh:
宝可梦
联盟？坚持下去!

en:
What a surprise! I didn't expect to
see a TRAINER out in the sea.{WAIT_CLEAR}I think we should battle!
zh: 真是惊喜！我没想到会在海里看到一位训练师。我觉得我们应该对战！

en: This kid's awfully tough…
zh: 这孩子非常坚强……

en:
Your eyes have that look of someone
who's experienced harsh challenges{WAIT_SCROLL}and won. It suits you well!
zh:
你的眼睛很像某人
他经历了严酷的挑战并取得了胜利。它很适合你！

en:
In the deep blue sea,
my shattered blue heart finds{WAIT_SCROLL}comfort among waves.
zh: 在深蓝的海洋中，我破碎的蓝色心灵在波浪中找到了慰藉。

en: attered blue heart finds{WAIT_SCROLL}comfort among waves.
zh: 忧伤的心在波涛中找到安慰。

en: MON spans{WAIT_SCROLL}depths beyond belief.
zh: 口袋妖怪的跨度 {WAIT_SCROLL} 深度超乎想象。

en:
The world's children dream
of one day becoming{WAIT_SCROLL}the POKéMON CHAMPION.
zh:
全世界的孩子都有梦想
希望有一天能成为宝可梦的冠军。

en: MON CHAMPION.
zh: 口袋妖怪冠军。

en:
Floating on the open sea like this…
It's peaceful.
zh: 像这样漂浮在开阔的海面上……这是和平的。

en: I needed to be a little less peaceful!
zh: 我需要稍微少一点平和！

en:
Swimming and battling like this…
I'm one happy guy…
zh: 像这样游泳和战斗……我真是个幸福的人……

en:
MON.
It's not easy swimming, I tell you.
zh: 星期一。我告诉你，游泳可不容易。

en:
MON raised by TRAINERS are
seriously tough…
zh:
由训练家提出的是
认真的艰难……

en:
Gasp… Gasp…
I'm wiped out…{WAIT_CLEAR}The going's easy. It's the leaving
that's the hard part.{WAIT_CLEAR}Will I have any energy left to make
the return trip?
zh:
喘息喘息…
我累坏了…{WAIT_CLEAR}这很容易。这是离开
这是最难的部分。{WAIT_SCROLL}我还有剩余的能量来制造
回程？

en:
The sea… The sea… The sea…
The sea as far as these eyes can see!{WAIT_SCROLL}I'm sick and tired of the sea!
zh: 海……这些眼睛所能看到的大海!{WAIT_SCROLL} 我厌倦了大海!

en: Bleah!
zh: 呸！

en:
Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.{WAIT_CLEAR}I'm a born swimmer!
That's what I am.
zh: 我在海边感到无聊，但我必须游泳。我是天生的游泳者！那就是我。

en:
Hi, sweetie, wait!
We should battle, you and I!
zh: 嗨，亲爱的，等等！我们应该来一场较量，你和我！

en:
You're tough in spite of the way
you look!
zh:
尽管方式不同，你还是很坚强
你看!

en:
Did you see a guy over there who whines
that he's bored of the sea?{WAIT_CLEAR}That's all talk.
He's hopelessly in love with the sea!
zh: 你看到那边有个抱怨对大海感到厌倦的人了吗？那只是说说而已。他对大海是彻底地痴恋！

en: Why do men love bathing suits so much?{WAIT_CLEAR}They all ogle me!
zh: 为什么男人这么喜欢泳衣？他们都盯着我看！

en: I'm out of my depth!
zh: 我力不从心！

en:
Maybe it's not my bathing suit that
makes men look. It must be my beauty!
zh: 也许不是我的泳衣吸引男人看，而一定是我的美貌！

en:
RELI: We'll work together as siblings
to take you on!
zh: : 我们将作为兄弟姐妹一起工作，带你去！

en:
RELI: We couldn't win even though we
worked together…
zh:
我们不能赢，即使我们
一起工作…

en: MON from{WAIT_SCROLL}the time they are born.
zh: 从他们出生的时候起的月份。

en:
MON?
We can't enjoy a battle, then.
zh:
妈妈？
那我们就不能享受战斗了。

en:
IAN: I'm doing my best together with
my sis!
zh:
伊恩：我正在和……一起努力
我的姐姐!

en:
IAN: I did my best with my sis,
but we still couldn't win…
zh:
伊恩: 我和我妹妹尽力了，
但我们还是赢不了……

en:
IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is
a floating town?{WAIT_CLEAR}So, wherever there is the sea,
that's a part of PACIFIDLOG!
zh:
伊恩: 你知道和平日志是怎样的
一个漂浮的城镇？{WAIT_CLEAR} 所以，无论哪里有大海，
这是和平日志的一部分!

en:
IAN: If you have two POKéMON,
we'll take you on!
zh:
伊恩：如果你有两个宝可梦，
我们要和你较量！

en:
o POKéMON,
we'll take you on!
zh:
口袋妖怪啊,
我们要和你较量！

en:
MON,
we'll take you on!
zh: 宝可梦，我们会和你一较高下！

en:
If you can beat me, I'll give you some
great information!
zh: 如果你能打败我，我就给你一些很棒的信息！

en:
Oh?
Did I lose?
zh: 哦？我输了吗？

en:
There is an odd place nearby.
There's a huge tower there.{WAIT_SCROLL}Why don't you go take a look?
zh:
附近有个奇怪的地方。
那里有一座巨大的塔。你为什么不去看看呢？

en:
The people of PACIFIDLOG are
a peaceful bunch.{WAIT_CLEAR}They never get angry.
That goes for me, too.
zh:
暮水镇的人民是
一群安静的人。{WAIT_CLEAR} 他们从不生气。
我也一样.

en: Oops!
zh: 哎呀！

en:
Tch! …Oh, wait.
I'm not angry. Honestly!{WAIT_CLEAR}But, boy, you're strong!
Hahaha!
zh:
总胆固醇!…哦,等。
我没有生气。老实说!{WAIT_CLEAR}但是，孩子，你很坚强！
哈哈哈!

en:
I used to catch colds all the time as
a kid, but I became totally fit after{WAIT_SCROLL}I started swimming.
zh: 我小时候经常感冒，但自从我开始游泳后，我变得完全健康了。

en: I crave more power…
zh: 我渴望更多的力量……

en:
TRAINERS travel the fields and
mountains, so they must be fit, too.
zh: 训练师穿越田野和山区，所以他们也必须保持健康。

en:
I try not to swim where the currents
are too strong.
zh:
我尽量不游泳的电流
太强大了。

en: Oh, please, no!
zh: Oh,请,否!

en:
If I get swept away, I'll lose all my
sense of place…
zh:
如果我被冲走，我就会失去我所有的
地方感……

en:
Win or lose, you'll never know until
you try!
zh:
赢或输，你永远不会知道，直到
你试一试!

en:
Waah!
I sank in defeat!
zh:
哇啊！
我失败了！

en:
I never battle when I know I'll win.
I like to battle at the razor's edge of{WAIT_SCROLL}victory and defeat!
zh: 我从不在我知道会赢的时候战斗。 我喜欢在胜利与失败的刀锋上战斗！

en:
MON 24 hours a day.
How could you possibly beat me?
zh:
星期一，一天24小时。
你怎么可能打败我？

en:
I lose.
I will concede defeat.
zh:
我输了。
我将承认失败。

en:
MON 24 hours
a day, don't you?
zh:
星期一24小时
一天，是吗？

en:
I'm always with my husband,
but I can win even without him.
zh:
我总是和我丈夫在一起，
但是即使没有他，我也可以赢。

en: Oh, I guess I wasn't good enough.
zh: 哦，我猜我不够好。

en:
That young man over there looks just
like my husband when he was young.{WAIT_CLEAR}He's making me blush!
zh: 那边的年轻男人看起来就像我年轻时的丈夫一样。他让我脸红了！

en:
Someone's been watching me intently.
Was it you?
zh:
有人一直在注视着我。
是你吗？

en:
Wow!
That's pretty strong, all right!
zh: 哇！那真的相当强啊！

en:
I can't shake this feeling that
someone's watching me.{WAIT_CLEAR}I can't concentrate!
zh:
我无法摆脱这种感觉
有人在监视我。我无法集中精神！

en:
that
someone's watching me.{WAIT_CLEAR}I can't concentrate!
zh:
那
有人在监视我。我无法集中精神！

en:
Now where could my wife have gone?
I'm always with her.{WAIT_SCROLL}I wonder if I can win on my own.
zh:
我妻子会去哪儿呢？
我总是和她在一起。{WAIT_CLEAR}我不知道我自己能不能赢。

en:
Ah, I see that I couldn't manage
to win on my own after all.
zh:
啊，我看到我无法管理
毕竟要靠我自己赢。

en:
My wife must be looking for me.
I'd best go find her right away.
zh:
我妻子一定在找我。
我最好马上去找她。

en:
I liked training here by myself.
It's awful that all these people came!
zh: 我喜欢自己在这里训练。真糟糕，居然来了这么多人！

en:
Okay! I won't complain about other
people being here.
zh:
好的！我不会抱怨其他
人们在这里。

en:
I suppose I can partner up with that
old man and challenge that other team.
zh:
我想我可以和他合作
老人和挑战另一个队。

en: d man and challenge that other team.
zh: D人，挑战其他球队。

en:
Did the currents carry you here, too?
This must have been fated.{WAIT_SCROLL}Let's battle!
zh: 洋流也把你带到这里了吗？这一定是命中注定的。我们来战斗吧！

en:
Strong!
Too much so!
zh: 强！太强了！

en:
It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER
like you would drift here…{WAIT_SCROLL}I must be cursed…
zh: 真倒霉，居然像你这样的强硬训练师会飘到这里来……我一定是被诅咒了……

en:
tough TRAINER
like you would drift here…{WAIT_SCROLL}I must be cursed…
zh:
艰难的训练
我一定是被诅咒了……

en:
I've led a life of woe and misery…
I've been cast away, and this is where{WAIT_SCROLL}I've drifted…
zh: 我的一生充满了悲伤和痛苦……我被抛弃了，这就是我漂泊的地方……

en: Another loss…
zh: 又一次失败…

en:
A life adrift…
I don't want it anymore!
zh: 漂泊的人生……我不想再要了！

en:
Welcome!
I've been expecting you!
zh: 欢迎！我一直在等你！

en: No! Please!
zh: 否!请!

en:
A strong child TRAINER…
That's so annoying!
zh: 一个强壮的孩子训练师… 真让人烦！

en:
I want to win like everyone else, but I
won't raise POKéMON like everyone else.
zh:
我想和其他人一样赢，但我
